settings.title: What to Prepare for Your Conference Permit Application

settings.editor: Send these details for our initial review. The official document list is confirmed against the relevant service and your conference's circumstances.

settings.description_text: The organizing entity, applicant's role, company information and relevant authorizations.
The conference objectives, main themes, draft agenda and session formats.
Proposed speakers, their roles and the topics they will cover.
The proposed venue, capacity, location and estimated number of attendees.
Proposed conference dates, event duration and any setup or additional activity days.
Sponsors, booth plans, exhibition areas and any other activities accompanying the conference.
